channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA SLPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #SLPRSD
Issued at 06:00 AM 23 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #Masbate(Mobo, CityOfMasbate, Milagros, Uson, Batuan, SanFernando) and #NorthernSamar(SanVicente) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
